m.s: Take {scotch} out of the fridge 20 minutes before cooking, pat dry and season generously with salt.
Cut {potato} into 2cm cubes and boil for 6 minutes until just tender. Drain and let them steam dry for 2 minutes.
Finely chop {parsley}, {mint}, {capers} and {garlic}. Mix with the zest and juice of {lemon}, about 3 tbsp olive oil for every 2 serves and a pinch of salt. It should be loose and punchy.
Fry the potatoes in a good splash of oil over medium-high heat for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until golden and crisp. Keep them warm in a low oven.

Heat a heavy frying pan over high heat until smoking. Cook the steaks for 3 to 4 minutes a side for medium-rare (55°C inside), adding {butter} for the last minute and spooning it over. Rest for 5 minutes. Don't skip the rest.

While the steak rests, char {asparagus} in the steak pan for 3 minutes. Slice the steak against the grain and serve with the potatoes and asparagus, salsa verde spooned over and the resting juices poured on top.

l: Slice the steak and pack it cold with the potatoes and asparagus, salsa verde in a separate container. Best eaten cold or at room temperature, not microwaved. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
g: Naturally gluten free. Nothing to swap.
